name: main_menu
description: Startup/bootstrap path of SporeApp.exe 3.1.0.22 (GOG). Values are LINKED addresses (= Ghidra VAs at base 0x400000; tracer plants at loadBase + (rva - image_base)). Verified 2026-09-21 by objdump (ImageBase 0x400000, AddressOfEntryPoint 0xde11a0) + byte inspection of the exe (function prologues / getter body / entry bootstrap). NOT live-Ghidra-verified (headless GhidraMCP cannot open programs). CAUTION: the first committed version had entry as file RVA 0xde11a0 (plants 0x400000 low, mid-.text); fixed to linked 0x11e11a0. InitPlugins 0x7e93d0 is the SDK slot address and looks ~384B inside the init body (nearest prologue-like boundary 0x7e9250) — kept as-is, still fires when InitPlugins executes.

probes.name: entry
probes.note: PE AddressOfEntryPoint (RVA 0xde11a0) + ImageBase. Bytes at file off 0xde05a0: e8 (call) + e9 (jmp) MSVC bootstrap.

probes.name: App::Bootstrap::local_main
probes.note: Valid prologue (mov eax,[esp+4]; sub esp; push esi/edi). Adjacent to 0xde11a0 with mutual call/jmp (objdump); local CRT-like main.

probes.name: App::Bootstrap::stateMachine
probes.note: FUN_00e20860, the bootstrap state machine (functional WinMain body per docs/RECON-3.1.0.22.md).

probes.name: App::cAppSystem::Startup
probes.note: vtable slot 1; creates subsystems, loads Preferences, starts renderer ('Could not start the renderer' path).

probes.name: App::cAppSystem::InitPlugins
probes.note: SDK-named via Spore-ModAPI symbol import; matches RECON absolute. Bytes show it is ~384B inside the init body (nearest prologue-like boundary 0x7e9250) but instruction-aligned, so it still fires when InitPlugins executes.

probes.name: App::IAppSystem::Get
probes.note: Global app-system accessor; 695 callers per RECON doc. High-frequency probe (exercises per-function event cap).
